$comment: Machine-readable Valyd capability matrix for AI agents. Each entry maps a real integration goal to a stable id, its path, product, auth header, required credentials, whether it is billable, how PII is handled, whether a proof is saved to the user's Valyd account, and the agent-fetchable .md doc (root-relative; resolve against the docs host you fetched this file from). Verification has TWO lanes: Managed by Valyd (signed-in user, hosted, ALL checks, proofs saved to their Valyd ID) and Verify Fresh (no login, non-account, ONLY liveness + uniqueness, hosted or direct API, result returns to you). Every field is derived from the Agent Integration Guide (/ai/agent-guide) and llms.txt — nothing here is invented. Credentials cannot be minted by an agent; a human creates apps/keys in the Developer Portal.

capabilities.goal: Sign a user in and read their verified Valyd account (profile, licenses, verification proofs)
Read the proofs a signed-in user's account already holds (id_verified, age bands, licenses) — free, no check runs
capabilities.credential: the user's Bearer valyd_access_token (from Login with Valyd)

capabilities.goal: Managed by Valyd: send a SIGNED-IN user to Valyd's hosted capture flow with their valyd_access_token. ALL checks are available (ID/KYC, liveness, face match, age, professional license, face uniqueness, location); passed proofs save to their Valyd ID and the raw identity data stays encrypted with Valyd — you receive the decision + proofs, never raw PII.
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key + workflow_id + the user's valyd_access_token on the session

capabilities.goal: Verify Fresh: NON-account verification with no user login — only liveness and uniqueness (face-uniqueness) checks. Run it on Valyd's hosted page OR call the direct API (POST /api/v2/liveness, /face-uniqueness, /antispoof) from your backend; the result returns to your system (nothing is saved to a Valyd account). Every other check (ID/KYC, face match, age, license, location) is Managed-by-Valyd only.
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key (+ workflow_id for the hosted flow)

capabilities.goal: Onboard and control a workforce as organization members (face-activation, owner/admin/developer/member roles, per-seat billing); track who logged in via the valyd_org_member_id claim
capabilities.credential: client_id + client_secret (Login with Valyd) + Members API headers X-Client-Id / X-Client-Secret (server-side only)
